notes.title: FPS Fest!
notes.content:
[b]Hello![/b]

     [b]A demo[/b] for our game is going to be [b]available[/b] to the public during the [b]FPS Festival[/b] here on Steam from [b]April 15th-22nd[/b].  Aggregate Core is in early development, so things are subject to change, but come play it, give us feedback and be a part of that change! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44127029/d501f2016a2fa6809f673b15b9c880590c344053.jpg[/img]

     There is a link in the games menu that takes you to a feedback form on google if anyone is interested in using it, and there are links to our socials if you'd like to follow the development of the game.

[previewyoutube=Vo2aU8PL4Dw;full][/previewyoutube]
